issues_detected.title: Cracking in Concrete
issues_detected.description: The concrete driveway exhibits significant cracking, which may indicate settling or movement of the underlying soil.
issues_detected.recommendation: Consult a professional to assess the extent of the damage and consider repair options such as patching or resurfacing.
